premise: The leaves turn red and gold and fall; Fox builds a huge pile, and just before he jumps he hears Hedgehog snoring inside.
inspiration: The folk 'big jump' pattern (one, two, three, go!), turned into a hide-and-seek surprise: the pile was already somebody's bed.
lesson: Surprises are more fun when everyone joins in.
learning: Leaves change colour and fall in autumn

en-US.title: The Great Leaf Pile
en-US.text: The leaves on the big trees turned red, and orange, and gold. {canvas:wind 0.5 8s} Then the wind blew, whoosh, {canvas:leaves 0.8 20s} and down they came, twirling and swirling to the ground. {hedgehog:enter} Hedgehog came scurrying by, very sleepy. [softly] What a soft bed! {hedgehog:live hold} He tucked in his nose and curled into a ball, deep in the leaves. Along trotted {fox:enter} Fox. {fox:face happy} [excited] Let's make the BIGGEST leaf pile! {acorn:enter} Acorn came running on her little feet. {acorn:hop x2} Together they pushed in leaves, big and small, until the pile was taller than Fox. One… two… {fox:face surprised} WAIT! {fox:live} Fox pricked up his ears, closed his eyes and listened… {sfx:snore} A tiny snore! [curious] {acorn:face surprised} Who's in there? {hedgehog:live resume} Hedgehog uncurled, peeked out and sniffed, covered in leaves from nose to toes. {hedgehog:face happy} [giggles] {acorn:wobble} You look like a leaf pile yourself! laughed Acorn. [happily] {fox:face happy} So all three counted, one, two, THREE… {fox:hop} {acorn:hop} {hedgehog:hop} and jumped in together. {sfx:crunch} CRUNCH!

es-ES.title: El gran montón de hojas
es-ES.text: Las hojas de los árboles grandes se volvieron rojas, y naranjas, y doradas. {canvas:wind 0.5 8s} Entonces sopló el viento, fiuuu, {canvas:leaves 0.8 20s} y las hojas bajaron dando vueltas hasta el suelo. {hedgehog:enter} Erizo pasó correteando, con mucho sueño. [softly] ¡Qué cama tan blandita! {hedgehog:live hold} Escondió la nariz y se hizo una bola, bien hundido entre las hojas. Llegó trotando {fox:enter} Zorro. {fox:face happy} [excited] ¡Vamos a hacer el montón de hojas MÁS GRANDE! {acorn:enter} Bellota llegó corriendo con sus piececitos. {acorn:hop x2} Juntos amontonaron hojas grandes y pequeñas, hasta que el montón fue más alto que Zorro. Una… dos… {fox:face surprised} ¡ESPERA! {fox:live} Zorro levantó las orejas, cerró los ojos y escuchó… {sfx:snore} ¡Un ronquidito! [curious] {acorn:face surprised} ¿Quién hay ahí? {hedgehog:live resume} Erizo se desenrolló, asomó la nariz y olfateó, lleno de hojas hasta las orejas. {hedgehog:face happy} [giggles] {acorn:wobble} ¡Pareces un montoncito de hojas!, se rio Bellota. [happily] {fox:face happy} Así que los tres contaron: una, dos, ¡TRES!… {fox:hop} {acorn:hop} {hedgehog:hop} y saltaron dentro a la vez. {sfx:crunch} ¡CRUNCH!

crunch.prompt: a small animal jumping into a big crunchy pile of dry autumn leaves

snore.prompt: one tiny, soft, cute snore of a small sleeping animal
